text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD:INC-8912: rate limiter anomaly: sudden 429 surge for routed tokens. Auto-escalation to on-call.

pagerduty-bot: page to alice (on-call), ben (secondary) sent. Incident start: 2891110000

alice: seeing it — dashboards show a sharp spike in 429s starting ~2891109980. Looks like a routing/mapper change rolled ~5m ago.

ben: impact? customer-facing? any retries/backoff symptoms?

chandra: quick glance: 429s concentrated on the token-route service 10.3.4.* cluster. Top tenants: tenant-42, tenant-acme, tenant-omega. Increase in per-tenant rejects by ~12x.

alice: confirmed. Metric snippets:
```
limiter.request_count{env=prod,route=token-route}  31245
limiter.rejected_count{env=prod,route=token-route}  25890
limiter.reject_rate{env=prod,route=token-route}  0.828
```

alice: logs show quota-mapper emitted a WARN then a config push: `quota-mapper v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0` at ~2891109975.

derek: that matches the deploy window I saw for the mapper config propagation. Could be a mapping collision: some tokens got assigned to fallback policy with 0 capacity.

frank: running quick query for mapping table anomalies...

frank: result: ~4% of tokens mapped to _uninitialized_ bucket due to missing tenant id during join. Those tokens hit an enforced zero-quota rule.

ben: can we patch the mapper to treat missing tenant as transient (soft-throttle) while we investigate?

alice: yeah — plan: 1) flip quota-mapper to soft-mode (non-enforcing) 2) rollback the config push if flip doesn't stabilize 3) whitelist top affected tenants to bypass limiter 4) notify CS + PD.

chandra: I can flip soft-mode now. Command: 
```
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/quota-mapper -- /app/ctl set-mode --soft
```

chandra: executing now...

incident-bot: action queued: run job quota-mapper-set-mode-soft by chandra

chandra: done. soft-mode enabled. Confirming metrics in 30s.

alice: metrics trending — reject_rate down from 0.828 -> 0.22 in 45s. Good.

ben: initiate tenant whitelists for the top 3 impacted tenants while we validate. Use auth bypass rule.

frank: whitelisting tenant-42 and tenant-acme done. tenant-omega queued, applying.

cs-notify-bot: Customer success notification template sent to CS channel for tenant-42, tenant-acme, tenant-omega.

pagerduty-bot: PD:INC-8912 updated: mitigation in progress (soft-mode + whitelists). No data loss; customer requests may have retried.

alice: still seeing a residual bump in errors but within SLOs. I'll keep monitoring for 15m. If stabilizes, we can avoid full rollback.

derek: do we want an emergency rollback of quota-mapper config to previous version? If root cause is bad config, rollback is safer.

ben: yes — prepare rollback but don't execute until we confirm soft-mode is stable for 10m. frank, can you prepare the rollback manifest?

frank: rollback manifest ready: `quota-mapper-config:v3.2.1` pre-approved.

alice: 10m checkpoint: reject_rate steady ~0.18. Top tenants cleared. No new PD escalations.

ben: CS loop: have we told customers to expect possible increased latency from retries?

cs-notify-bot: Sent update to tenant-42 and tenant-acme support contacts: brief note + apology + ETA for final update.

derek: logging note: capture the mapping diff and the token join payloads for postmortem. `s3://redwood-incident-archive/2891110000/mapping-diff.json`

alice: PD: close decision checklist: 
- Impact contained? yes (top tenants whitelisted, global soft-mode)
- Root cause known? partially (mapping null -> zero-quota)
- Customer notified? yes
- Rollback ready? yes

alice: marking incident as mitigated, leaving open for postmortem tasks. Will not close PD yet; set to monitor for 2h.

pagerduty-bot: PD:INC-8912 status -> acknowledged -> monitoring.

incident-bot: automated post: created incident ticket INC-8912-RT for postmortem assignment. Assigned to chandra, frank.

frank: follow-ups: add input validation to token-join pipeline, make quota-mapper default to soft for partial configs, add synthetic canary to detect mapping drops pre-deploy.

chandra: taking PMR ownership for remediation timeline. Est ETA 3 days for quick fixes, 2 weeks for full guardrails.

alice: thanks all. Final note: if reject_rate jumps back above 0.4, unmute pagerduty and escalate to SEV.

incident-bot: automated note: incident marked mitigated at 2891110900.
